profile.headline:  Senior Software Engineer @Apple / Claris
profile.summary:
Programming Languages: Golang, Javascript, Typescript, Python, Java, C/C++
Expertise:
•  Frontend: HTML • CSS • Next • React • Redux • Angular • Storybook 
•  Backend: Golang • Node.js • Django • REST API
•  DevOps/Test: Git • Docker • Kubernetes • Vercel • Jest/Enzyme • Ginkgo
•  Cloud/Database: AWS • Google Cloud Platform • MongoDB • MySQL
•  Tools: Atlassian (Jira • Confluence) • Github • Bitbuckit • VSCode

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Software Architecture · Go (Programming Language) · MongoDB · Apache Kafka · gRPC · Software Infrastructure · Software Documentation · Kubernetes · Docker · Engineering · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Data Migration · Unit Testing · Test-Driven Development · Design Documents · Agile Methodologies

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Join Claris International Inc., formerly FileMaker Inc., is a computer software development company formed as a subsidiary company of Apple Computer in 1987.

Accomplishments:
- Built a history-audit application using MongoBD Change Stream
- Developed Go application w/ CRUD APIs, store data in MongoDB and unit testing
- Created command-line (CLI) application for test automation w/ Go Cobra 
- Ensured code and design meets Apple’s coding standards and best practices
positions.insights: Skills: Golang · MongoDB · Microservices · Command line · Change stream · Unit Testing · Backend Development · Engineering

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Mission:  Enhance the world's ability to create, edit, & publish content at scale in order to entertain, educate, & inspire for generations to come.

Accomplishments:
- Worked directly with the CEO to develop Vidbase.
- Built UI component library using Storybook.
- Built new features for Vidbase using three.js, react-three-fiber & react-spring.
- Mastered Nextjs, Typescript & Styled-Components.
- Integrated automated/unit testing and snapshot using Jest/Enzyme.
- Created tutorial blogs to show the tool's usage and building process. 
- Designed and developed animated SVG icons using Figma and CSS.
positions.insights: Skills: Front-End Development · JavaScript · TypeScript · React.js · Next.js · Storybooks · styled-components · Three.js · Jest · Enzyme · Figma

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Mission: Accelerate the world’s transition to sustainable energy

Accomplishment:
- Developed new features that saved millions of lost inventories.
- Worked closely with MOS developers and QA engineers on a daily basis.
- Intensive design, develop and testing using Angular, Golang, MySQL & Ginkgo.
- Boosted manufacturing process and released 20+ Jira tickets to production.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · AngularJS · Golang · MySQL · ginkgo · Monolithic Architecture · Full-Stack Development

positions.title: Cloud Engineer
positions.description:
Mission: Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem around the world. 

Accomplishment:
- Developed crowd-sourced data collection internal tool for Roku Voice team.
- Built using React, AWS Mechanical Turk API & deployed securely to AWS.
- Collaborated with research intern to designed scalable experiments.
- Surpassed initial goal by releasing 5 campaigns to production in 3 months.
- Explored new methods of collecting data to improve voice search functionality.
- Delivered detailed project documentations for future development.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · React.js · AWS Mechanical Turk · Amazon S3

positions.title: Senior Mentor
positions.description:
- Increased student enrollment in ESL by 45% through 1-on-1 tutoring and innovative ESL workshops.
- Trained and mentored six tutors through formal tutor training.
- Elevated students’ confidence and English language skills.

positions.title: Mentor/English as a Second Language Tutor
positions.description:
- Completed a Tutor Training Course to develop effective communication and leadership skills.
- Led one-on-one tutoring and workshops with a variety of topics to improve students’ language communication skills and confidence.
- Initiated new ideas and delivery methods for ESL workshops that attract more students.

positions.title: Webmaster/Historian Vice President
positions.locationName: Alpha Sigma Alpha at De Anza College
positions.description:
– Maintain and update the Chapter website. 
– Review the NV/CA Regional Website and the International Website for relevant information.
– Keep a chronological history of all Chapter meetings, events, and functions. 
– Prepare and maintain the chapter yearbook.

- Ladder is a professional community platform for the next generation to find opportunities, participate in discussions, and grow their careers together.
- Assisting founders to build communities related to Software Engineering, Product Management, and Design (UI/UX) for students/new grad
